title: Helping Employers Become SkillBridge Providers
description: Most employers do not know they can host SkillBridge participants. This course teaches staff to coach an employer through becoming an authorized provider, pairing SkillBridge with a registered apprenticeship, and earning the HIRE Vets Medallion.
notes: Audience: Business services, LVERs, employer engagement staff. Format: LV. Hours assumed from format (LV = 3 hours).
learning_objectives: Explain the SkillBridge provider application and MOU requirements.
Design a SkillBridge experience that flows directly into a Registered Apprenticeship.
Describe HIRE Vets Medallion criteria and how SkillBridge supports them.
Track SkillBridge-to-hire outcomes for the employer and the board.

sequencing_rationale: Lessons follow the catalog's learning objectives in the order a practitioner meets them on the job: Becoming an Authorized SkillBridge Provider; Designing a SkillBridge-to-Apprenticeship Pathway; The HIRE Vets Medallion; Tracking SkillBridge-to-Hire Outcomes. The closing project ("Project: Employer Coaching Plan") applies the earlier lessons to one realistic work product (an employer coaching plan covering the provider application, a SkillBridge-to-apprenticeship design, Medallion alignment, and outcome tracking) rather than introducing new content. Scope assumptions: hours are not stated in the source catalog and are assumed from the delivery format (LV; LV = 3 hours). Content is grounded in California and federal guidance named in the catalog description and objectives; the course cites those directives by number but does not reproduce their text, and every policy-specific claim must be checked against the current directive before delivery. Local board policy is treated as a variable the learner fills in from their own board, not something the course prescribes. Prerequisites reflect track order: VET 101 (SkillBridge for AJCC Staff); APP 101 (Registered Apprenticeship for Workforce Professionals).
